    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    SENTINEL is built on the conviction that security fluency is a strategic capability — not a uniform alone. Every module pairs business-English precision with operational judgment, protective literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium security leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern security services — from the foundations of physical security and risk assessment to AI-powered threat detection and smart surveillance.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — incident reporting, access control decisions, patrol planning, emergency response — written for international security professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. SENTINEL reflects his vision: security fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and protective credibility.

    Designed for the security officers, site supervisors, and protection leaders shaping how the world stays safe — SENTINEL is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for the incident that never happens.
